title: CapabilityMatrixEntry
description: One observed row of the capability matrix (NS-07, PRP-01 Clarification 17; amended in place for PRP-02 Item 0, schema_version 1.1.0): whether a service feature is offered for a cloud, region and SKU, as stated by a cited source on a given date. Contract only; data and loader belong to PRP-02. availability, ga_status and authorization_scope are three independent fields and must never be merged into one status. authorization_scope is a citation of the audit-scope text the source gives for the Azure service, or the literal none_claimed; it is never a claim that NeuroSphere or the dependency is authorized for any agency, an ATO or compliance parity. Unavailable combinations are disabled with a reason, never filled by routing to another cloud. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are checked by the Python validator check_capability_matrix in tests/contracts/validators.py (PRP-01 item 7): (service, feature, cloud, region, sku) is unique across a matrix; id is unique and equals the derived convention; observed_on is not in the future; a government wildcard region covers government regions only.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this document (semver within major 1).

id.description: Stable canonical citation handle for this row, used by ADRs and capability_unavailable reasons. Convention (enforced by check_capability_matrix so it cannot drift from the uniqueness key): <service>.<feature>.<cloud>.<region>.<sku-or-any>, lowercased, with any for a null sku and for the * region; a sku is lowercased and each run of characters outside a-z, 0-9, _ and - becomes a single -, trimmed of leading and trailing -.

service.description: Azure service key, snake_case (for example azure_openai, cosmos_db, fabric, synapse, databricks, ai_search, event_hubs).

feature.description: Feature key within the service, snake_case (for example model_gpt_4o, private_endpoint, change_feed). Use base for the service itself.

region.description: Lowercase ARM region name, global for non-regional offerings, or the wildcard * only when the cited source states the row holds for every region of the cloud. Government rows use usgov*/usdod* regions, global or *; a Government * covers Government regions only and never matches a Commercial region. Commercial rows may not use usgov*/usdod* regions.

sku.description: SKU or tier the row applies to; null when the row is SKU-independent (no * wildcard for sku).

availability.description: Is it offered here at all. unverified means the source does not say. Independent of ga_status and authorization_scope.

ga_status.description: Release maturity. not_applicable when maturity has no meaning (for example an unavailable row); unverified means the source does not say. Independent of availability and authorization_scope.

authorization_scope.description: Citation of the audit-scope document or status text the source gives for this service in this cloud (for example 'FedRAMP High audit scope per <document>, 2026-09-21' or 'FedRAMP High assessment in progress; not authorized'), or the literal none_claimed. A citation only: never a claim that NeuroSphere or the dependency is authorized for an agency. Independent of availability and ga_status.

source_url.description: HTTPS URL of the authoritative source for this row. Recorded, never fetched by tests.

observed_on.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) the source was observed.

notes.description: Caveats (for example region subset, quota or preview limits); null when none.
